definitions.explanation: A focused section or edition of a magazine, newspaper, or television program dedicated to a particular topic. Also used as a verb with する to mean producing such a feature.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}の{特集|とくしゅう}はダイエットだ。
examples.english: This month's special feature is about dieting.

examples.japanese: テレビで{桜|さくら}の{名所|めいしょ}を{特集|とくしゅう}していた。
examples.english: They were running a special feature on famous cherry blossom spots on TV.

examples.japanese: あの{雑誌|ざっし}の{旅行|りょこう}{特集|とくしゅう}を{読|よ}んで、{沖縄|おきなわ}に{行|い}きたくなった。
examples.english: After reading that magazine's travel special, I wanted to go to Okinawa.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in media contexts. Used as a noun ({特集|とくしゅう}{記事|きじ} — special feature article) or with する ({特集|とくしゅう}する — to feature, to run a special on). Japanese magazines frequently run themed {特集|とくしゅう} issues, and news programs use the word for in-depth segments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特集|とくしゅう}{記事|きじ}: feature article
- {特集|とくしゅう}{番組|ばんぐみ}: special feature program
- {特集|とくしゅう}{号|ごう}: special issue (of a magazine)
- {特集|とくしゅう}を{組|く}む: to put together a special feature
